Bank Entrance
This is the large entrance hall of the Bank of Zork, the largest banking institution of the Great Underground Empire.  A partial account of its history is in "The Lives of the Twelve Flatheads" with the chapter on J. Pierpont Flathead.  A more detailed history (albeit less objective) may be found in Flathead's outrageous autobiography "I'm Rich and You Aren't -- So There!"  Most of the furniture has been ravaged by passing scavengers.  All that remains are two signs at the northwest and northeast corners of the room, which say 

    <-- WEST VIEWING ROOM    EAST VIEWING ROOM -->

The lamp appears to be getting dimmer.

events.response:
Shaft Room
This is a large room, in the middle of which is a small shaft descending through the floor into darkness below.  To the west and the north are exits from this room.  Constructed over the top of the shaft is a metal framework to which a heavy iron chain is attached.

At the end of the chain is a basket.
The basket contains:
  a pile of coal
  a screwdriver
  an ivory torch (providing light)

East Teller's Room
This is a small square room, which was used by a bank officer whose job it was to retrieve safety deposit boxes for the customer.  On the north side of the room is a sign which reads "Viewing Room".  On the east side of the room, above an open door, is a sign reading 

            BANK PERSONNEL ONLY 

>

Flood Control Dam #3
You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to the north, south, east, and down.  There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the panel.  Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.  The green bubble is glowing.

There is a wrench here.

events.intent: Go east to Round Room on tail route
events.response:
Round Room
This is a circular room with passages off in eight directions.

There is a bottle here.
The bottle contains:
  a quantity of water

There is a piece of cake with orange icing here.
There is a dented steel box here.
The match has gone out.

>
events.expected_outcome: Round Room lit arrival, match out

events.intent: Go east from Round Room on tail route
events.response:
Grail Room

It is now pitch dark in here!

>
events.expected_outcome: Unknown room X, dark first turn

events.intent: Go west to Mine Entrance
events.response:
Mine Entrance
You are standing at the entrance of what might have been a coal mine.  To the northeast and the northwest are entrances to the mine, and there is another exit on the south end of the room.

>

events.intent: Go down the prominent staircase from Torch Room
events.response:
North-South Crawlway
This is a north-south crawlway; a passage also goes to the east.  There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.

>

events.intent: Crawl south to the Studio
events.response:
Studio
This is what appears to have been an artist's studio.  The walls and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors.  Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here.  At the north and northwest of the room are open doors (also covered with paint).  An extremely dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace.  Although you might be able to get up the chimney, it seems unlikely that you could get back down.

>

events.intent: Take the northwest door to the Gallery
events.response:
Gallery
This is an art gallery. Most of the paintings which were here have been stolen by vandals with exceptional taste. The vandals left through the north, south, or west exits.

Fortunately, there is still one chance for you to be a vandal, for on the far wall is a work of unparalleled beauty.
>

events.intent: Go south to Slide Room where rope is tied
events.response:
Slide Room
This is a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a coal mine.  On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite Wall" are etched in the rock.  To the east is a long passage and there is a steep metal slide twisting downward.  To the north is a small opening.

There is a large coil of rope here, tied to the broken timber.

>

events.intent: Test if matchbook holds a sixth match
events.response:
I'm afraid you have run out of matches.

>
events.expected_outcome: Either Grail lit or run out of matches

events.intent: Go west to Cellar
events.response:
Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

>

events.intent: Move south to Library on candles
events.response:
Library
This is a room which must have been a large library, probably for the royal family.  All of the shelves appear to have been gnawed to pieces by unfriendly gnomes.  To the north is an exit.

There is a blue book here.
There is a green book here.
There is a white book here.
There is a purple book here.
The candles grow shorter.

>

events.intent: Open purple book on candles to reveal stamp
events.response:
You open the purple book, revealing a Flathead stamp.

>

Ok.

>

events.intent: Return south to teller room
events.response:
Bank Entrance
This is the large entrance hall of the Bank of Zork, the largest banking institution of the Great Underground Empire.  A partial account of its history is in "The Lives of the Twelve Flatheads" with the chapter on J. Pierpont Flathead.  A more detailed history (albeit less objective) may be found in Flathead's outrageous autobiography "I'm Rich and You Aren't -- So There!"  Most of the furniture has been ravaged by passing scavengers.  All that remains are two signs at the northwest and northeast corners of the room, which say 

    <-- WEST VIEWING ROOM    EAST VIEWING ROOM -->

>

events.intent: Climb up to Living Room
events.response:
Living Room
This is the living room.  There is a door to the east.  To the west, there is a wooden door with strange gothic lettering and a cyclops-sized hole in it.

In the center of the room is an open trap door.
There is a trophy case here.
Your collection of treasures consists of:
  a stack of zorkmid bills
  a portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead
  a jade figurine
  a sapphire bracelet
  a huge diamond
  a red crystal sphere
  a crystal trident
  a blue crystal sphere
  a trunk of jewels
  a golden clockwork canary
  a beautiful brass bauble
  a platinum bar
  a grail
  a jewel-encrusted egg
  a chalice
  a bag of coins
  a masterpiece by a neglected genius

There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT here.
>

events.intent: Return northwest to teller room
events.response:
West Teller's Room
This is a small square room, which was used by a bank officer whose job it was to retrieve safety deposit boxes for the customer.  On the north side of the room is a sign which reads "Viewing Room".  On the west side of the room, above an open door, is a sign reading 

            BANK PERSONNEL ONLY 

In the center of the room is a large stone cube, about 10 feet on a side.  Engraved on the side of the cube is some lettering.
>

Egyptian Room
This is a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an ascending staircase in the room as well as doors east and south.

There is a stiletto here.
There is a broken sharp stick here.
There is a large shovel here.

This is a large rectangular room.  The east and west walls here were used for storing safety deposit boxes.  As might be expected, all have been carefully removed by evil persons.  The northern "wall" of the room is a shimmering curtain of light.  To the east, west, and south of the room are large doorways.

>

events.intent: East to Round Room
events.response:
Egyptian Room
This is a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an ascending staircase in the room as well as doors east and south.

There is a stiletto here.
There is a broken sharp stick here.
There is a large shovel here.
>

events.intent: Go west to Living Room
events.response:
Living Room
This is the living room.  There is a door to the east.  To the west, there is a wooden door with strange gothic lettering and a cyclops-sized hole in it.

In the center of the room is an open trap door.
There is a trophy case here.
Your collection of treasures consists of:
  a stack of zorkmid bills
  a portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead
  a jade figurine
  a sapphire bracelet
  a huge diamond
  a red crystal sphere
  a crystal trident
  a blue crystal sphere
  a trunk of jewels
  a golden clockwork canary
  a beautiful brass bauble
  a platinum bar
  a grail
  a jewel-encrusted egg
  a chalice
  a bag of coins
  a masterpiece by a neglected genius

There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT here.
>

events.intent: Return west to Safety Depository
events.response:
Safety Depository
This is a large rectangular room.  The east and west walls here were used for storing safety deposit boxes.  As might be expected, all have been carefully removed by evil persons.  The northern "wall" of the room is a shimmering curtain of light.  To the east, west, and south of the room are large doorways.

>

events.intent: Descend to Cellar
events.response:
Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

>

events.intent: Probe east from Safety Depository
events.response:
East Teller's Room
This is a small square room, which was used by a bank officer whose job it was to retrieve safety deposit boxes for the customer.  On the north side of the room is a sign which reads "Viewing Room".  On the east side of the room, above an open door, is a sign reading 

            BANK PERSONNEL ONLY 

>

events.intent: Find route back toward Stream and Dam with torch light
events.response:
Volcano View
You are on a ledge in the middle of a large volcano.  Below you the volcano bottom can be seen and above is the rim of the volcano.  A couple of ledges can be seen on the other side of the volcano; it appears that this ledge is intermediate in elevation between those on the other side.  The exit from this room is to the east.

>

Ok.

>

events.intent: Follow Volcano View exit east
events.response:
Egyptian Room

There is a stiletto here.
There is a broken sharp stick here.
There is a large shovel here.
>

events.intent: Disembark at Bottom
events.response:
You get out of the basket.

Volcano Bottom
You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano.  High above you, light may be seen entering from the cone of the volcano.  The only exit here is to the north.

There is a very large and extremely heavy wicker basket with a cloth bag here.  Inside the basket is a metal receptacle of some kind.  Attached to the basket on the outside is a piece of wire.
>

events.intent: Go east through personnel door

Safety Depository

>

events.intent: Go east to Troll Room
events.response:
Troll Room
This is a small room with passages off in all directions.  Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.

>

events.intent: Go north to EWP
events.response:
East-West Passage
This is a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.

There is a leaflet here.
There is an elvish sword here.
>

events.intent: Probe south from Safety Depository
events.response:
Chairman's Office
This room was the office of the Chairman of the Bank of Zork.  Like the other rooms here, it has been extensively vandalized.  The lone exit is to the north.

A portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead hangs on the wall.
>

events.intent: Try east door toward Rocky and Dam Lobby
events.response:
Rocky Crawl
This is a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot.  Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the passage.

>

events.intent: Bottom north to Lava
events.response:
Lava Room
This is a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow.  There are exits here to the west and the south.

>

events.intent: West from Rocky to Ravine toward Dam Lobby
events.response:
Deep Ravine
This is a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway.  Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine, and a steep staircase descends.

>

events.intent: Lava west to Ruby
events.response:
Ruby Room
This is a small chamber behind the remains of the great glacier.  To the south and west are small passageways.

>

events.intent: Go north to Deep Ravine
events.response:
Deep Ravine
This is a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway.  Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine, and a steep staircase descends.

>

Living Room

There is a trophy case here.
Your collection of treasures consists of:
  a stack of zorkmid bills
  a portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead
  a fancy violin
  a gold coffin (open but empty)
  a pot of gold
  a statue

  a white crystal sphere
  a tin of rare spices
  a pearl necklace
  a gold card
  a crystal trident

  a sapphire bracelet
  a huge diamond

  a trunk of jewels
  a golden clockwork canary
  a beautiful brass bauble
  a platinum bar
  a grail
  a jewel-encrusted egg
  a chalice

  a masterpiece by a neglected genius

events.intent: Go west to Rocky Crawl
events.response:
Rocky Crawl
This is a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot.  Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the passage.

>

Ok.

events.intent: Go east to Dome Room
events.response:
Dome Room
You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a wooden railing which circles the dome.

>

events.intent: West to Strange Passage

Strange Passage
This is a long passage.  To the south is one entrance.  On the east there is an old wooden door with a large hole in it (about cyclops sized).

>

events.intent: South to Cyclops Room
events.response:
Cyclops Room
This is a room with an exit on the west side, and a staircase leading up.

The north wall, previously solid, now has a cyclops-shaped hole in it.
>

events.intent: Descend to dark Cellar carrying bell
events.response:
Darkness
It is pitch black.  You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

>

events.intent: Descend the rope to Torch Room
events.response:
Torch Room
This is a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down staircase.  To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel, covered with a thin layer of dust.  Above you is a large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites.  Up around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing.  In the center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.

>

events.intent: Light match to see Cellar
events.response:
One of the matches starts to burn.

Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

>

events.intent: Up the Cyclops Room staircase toward Studio/Attic to find brick
events.response:
Treasure Room
This is a large room, whose north wall is solid granite.  A number of discarded bags, which crumble at your touch, are scattered about on the floor.  There is an exit down and what appears to be a newly created passage to the east.

>

events.intent: Go west through dusty tunnel to Tiny Room
events.response:
Tiny Room
This is a tiny room, which has an exit to the east.

On the north side of the room is a massive wooden door, near the top of which, in the center, is a window barred with iron.  A formidable bolt lock is set within the door frame.  A keyhole lies within the lock.
There is a coil of thin shiny wire here.
>

events.intent: East through new passage from Treasure Room toward Studio/brick
events.response:
Small Square Room
This is a small square room, in the middle of which is a recently created hole through which you can barely discern the floor some ten feet below.  It doesn't seem likely you could climb back up.  There are exits to the west and south.

There is a piece of paper on the ground here.
>

events.intent: Cellar east to Troll Room
events.response:
Troll Room
This is a small room with passages off in all directions.  Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.

The match has gone out.

>
events.expected_outcome: Troll Room lit arrival, match out

events.intent: Take the coil of thin wire for the fuse
events.response:

>

events.intent: South from Small Square Room toward Studio

Side Room

>

There is a leaflet here.
There is an elvish sword here.
It is now pitch dark in here!

events.intent: Drop the brass bell to lighten load for coffin ferry
Head toward front of house to answer knocking
events.response:
Kitchen
This is the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to the west, and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open. 

>

events.intent: South to Dusty Room for fuse placement
events.response:
Darkness
It is pitch black.  You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

>

Ok.

>

events.intent: Bank candle life for Hades ritual
events.response:
That's not something you can switch.

>

events.intent: Circle to rear to route north
events.response:
Behind House
You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house is a window that is open.

>

events.intent: Light match to see box
events.response:
One of the matches starts to burn.

Dusty Room
You are in a dusty old room which is virtually featureless, except for an exit on the north side.

Embedded in the far wall, there is a rusty old box.  It appears that the box is somewhat damaged, since an oblong hole has been chipped out of the front of it.
>

events.intent: Place brick in box hole
events.response:
You put the square brick feeling like clay into the oblong hole.

The match has gone out.

>

events.intent: Verify candle/lantern state
events.response:
You are carrying:
  a Flathead stamp
  a priceless zorkmid
  a gaudy crown
  a note card
  a moby ruby
  a large black book
  a pair of candles
  a matchbook
  a battery-powered brass lantern (providing light)

>

events.intent: Circle north toward west front
events.response:
North of House
You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here, and all the windows are barred.

>

events.intent: Reach front/west side where knocking came from
events.response:
West of House
You are in an open field on the west side of a white house with a boarded front door.

There is a small mailbox here.
The small mailbox contains:
  a free brochure

>

events.intent: Light match to see brick for fuse
events.response:
One of the matches starts to burn.

>

events.intent: Exit basket at Bottom
events.response:
You get out of the basket.

Volcano Bottom
You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano.  High above you, light may be seen entering from the cone of the volcano.  The only exit here is to the north.

There is a very large and extremely heavy wicker basket with a cloth bag here.  Inside the basket is a metal receptacle of some kind.  Attached to the basket on the outside is a piece of wire.
>

events.intent: Bottom north to Lava
events.response:
Lava Room
This is a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow.  There are exits here to the west and the south.

The lamp appears to be getting dimmer.

>

events.intent: Take the delivered brochure using everyday grab phrasing
events.response:
That's not a verb I recognise.

>

events.intent: Insert fuse into brick
events.response:
You insert the fuse into the brick.

The match has gone out.

>

events.intent: Light match to ignite fuse
events.response:
One of the matches starts to burn.

>

events.intent: Lava west to Ruby
events.response:
Ruby Room
This is a small chamber behind the remains of the great glacier.  To the south and west are small passageways.

>

events.intent: Take the delivered brochure with canonical phrasing
events.response:
(the free brochure)
Taken.

>

events.intent: Take the delivered brochure
Ignite fuse
events.response:
The wire starts to burn.

The match has gone out.

>

events.intent: Ruby south to Glacier
events.response:
Glacier Room
This is a large room with giant icicles hanging from the walls and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.

>

events.intent: Glacier north to Stream
events.response:
Stream View
You are standing on a path beside a gently flowing stream.  The path travels to the north and the east.

There is a burned-out ivory torch here.
>

events.intent: Read delivered brochure to find affixed stamp
events.response:
(the free brochure)
The mailing label on this glossy brochure from MIT Tech reads 

               Intrepid Adventurer
               c/o Local Dungeon Master
               White House, GUE
From the Introduction:

The brochure describes, for the edification of the prospective student, the stringent but wide-ranging curriculum of MIT Tech.  Required courses are offered in Ambition, Distraction, Uglification, and Derision.  The Humanities are not slighted at this institution, as the student may register for Reeling and Writhing, Mystery (Ancient and Modern), Seaography, and Drawling (which includes Stretching and Fainting in Coils).  Advanced students are expected to learn Laughing and Grief.

                                 William Barton Flathead, Founder

(The brochure continues in this vein for a few hundred more pages.)
Affixed loosely to the brochure is a small stamp.


>

events.intent: North to ledge away from fuse
events.response:
Wide Ledge
You are on a wide ledge high into the volcano.  The rim of the volcano is about 200 feet above and there is a precipitous drop below to the bottom.  There is a small door to the south.

There is a very large and extremely heavy wicker basket with a cloth bag here.  Inside the basket is a metal receptacle of some kind.  Attached to the basket on the outside is a piece of wire.
There is a tiny hook here.
There is an explosion nearby.

>

events.intent: Take burned-out torch
events.response:
Taken.

>

events.intent: Read exorcism prayer by candlelight
events.response:
Commandment #12592
Oh ye who go about saying unto each other: "Hello sailor":
Dost thou know the magnitude of thy sin before the gods?
Yea, verily, thou shalt be ground between two stones.
Shall the angry gods cast thy body into the whirlpool?
Surely, thy eye shall be put out with a sharp stick!
Even unto the ends of the earth shalt thou wander and
unto the land of the dead shalt thou be sent at last.
Surely thou shalt repent of thy cunning.


Each word of the prayer reverberates through the hall in a deafening confusion.  As the last word fades, a voice, loud and commanding, speaks: "Begone, fiends!".  A heart-stopping scream fills the cavern, and the spirits, sensing a greater power, flee through the walls.

events.intent: Read exorcism prayer
events.response:
Commandment #12592
Oh ye who go about saying unto each other: "Hello sailor":
Dost thou know the magnitude of thy sin before the gods?
Yea, verily, thou shalt be ground between two stones.
Shall the angry gods cast thy body into the whirlpool?
Surely, thy eye shall be put out with a sharp stick!
Even unto the ends of the earth shalt thou wander and
unto the land of the dead shalt thou be sent at last.
Surely thou shalt repent of thy cunning.


Each word of the prayer reverberates through the hall in a deafening confusion.  As the last word fades, a voice, loud and commanding, speaks: "Begone, fiends!".  A heart-stopping scream fills the cavern, and the spirits, sensing a greater power, flee through the walls.

>

A passage exits to the west.

I hope you have more light than from a pair of candles.

It is now pitch dark in here!

This is the Tomb of the Unknown Implementer.  A hollow voice says:  "That's not a bug, it's a feature!"  In the north wall of the room is the Crypt of the Implementers.  It is made of the finest marble, and apparently large enough for four headless corpses.  The crypt is closed.  Above the entrance is the cryptic instruction: "Feel Free".

events.intent: Read prayer
events.response:
Commandment #12592
Oh ye who go about saying unto each other: "Hello sailor":
Dost thou know the magnitude of thy sin before the gods?
Yea, verily, thou shalt be ground between two stones.
Shall the angry gods cast thy body into the whirlpool?
Surely, thy eye shall be put out with a sharp stick!
Even unto the ends of the earth shalt thou wander and
unto the land of the dead shalt thou be sent at last.
Surely thou shalt repent of thy cunning.


Each word of the prayer reverberates through the hall in a deafening confusion.  As the last word fades, a voice, loud and commanding, speaks: "Begone, fiends!".  A heart-stopping scream fills the cavern, and the spirits, sensing a greater power, flee through the walls.

Living Room
This is the living room.  There is a door to the east.  To the west, there is a wooden door with strange gothic lettering and a cyclops-sized hole in it.

There is a trophy case here.
Your collection of treasures consists of:

  a trunk of jewels
  a golden clockwork canary
  a beautiful brass bauble
  a platinum bar
  a grail

  a masterpiece by a neglected genius

events.intent: Melt glacier with torch

Deep Ravine

>

events.intent: Go east to Egyptian Room
events.response:
Egyptian Room
This is a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb.  There is an ascending staircase in the room as well as doors east and south.

>

events.intent: Go east to Rocky Crawl
events.response:
Rocky Crawl
This is a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot.  Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the passage.

>

events.intent: Go west to Rocky Crawl
events.response:
Rocky Crawl
This is a crawlway with a three-foot high ceiling.  Your footing is very unsure here due to the assortment of rocks underfoot.  Passages can be seen in the east, west, and northwest corners of the passage.

>

events.intent: Go west to Deep Ravine
events.response:
Deep Ravine
This is a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway.  Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine, and a steep staircase descends.

>

events.intent: Go east to Dome Room
events.response:
Dome Room
You are at the periphery of a large dome, which forms the ceiling of another room below.  Protecting you from a precipitous drop is a wooden railing which circles the dome.

>

events.intent: Anchor rope to Dome railing for descent
events.response:
The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.

>

events.intent: Go south to EWP
events.response:
East-West Passage
This is a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.

There is a large black book here.
There is a leaflet here.
>

events.intent: Climb down rope to Torch Room
events.response:
Torch Room
This is a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down staircase.  To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel, covered with a thin layer of dust.  Above you is a large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites.  Up around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing.  In the center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.

>

events.intent: Cache sword at EWP
events.response:
Dropped.

>

events.intent: Recover black book for balloon
events.response:
Taken.

>

events.intent: Go west through dusty tunnel to Tiny Room
events.response:
Tiny Room
This is a tiny room, which has an exit to the east.

On the north side of the room is a massive wooden door, near the top of which, in the center, is a window barred with iron.  A formidable bolt lock is set within the door frame.  A keyhole lies within the lock.
There is a coil of thin shiny wire here.
>

events.intent: Take wire coil for balloon fuse
events.response:
Taken.

>

events.intent: Go north to Deep Ravine
events.response:
Deep Ravine
This is a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway.  Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine, and a steep staircase descends.

>

events.intent: Return east through dusty tunnel to Torch Room
events.response:
Torch Room
This is a large room with a prominent doorway leading to a down staircase.  To the west is a narrow twisting tunnel, covered with a thin layer of dust.  Above you is a large dome painted with scenes depicting elfin hacking rites.  Up around the edge of the dome (20 feet up) is a wooden railing.  In the center of the room there is a white marble pedestal.

>

events.intent: Descend to Reservoir South
events.response:
Reservoir South
This is a long room on the south shore of a large reservoir.  There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway climbing up along the edge of a cliff.

>

events.intent: Go west to Stream View
events.response:
Stream View
You are standing on a path beside a gently flowing stream.  The path travels to the north and the east.

>

events.intent: Descend to crawlway
events.response:
North-South Crawlway
This is a north-south crawlway; a passage also goes to the east.  There is a hole above, but it provides no opportunities for climbing.

>

events.intent: Go north to Glacier Room
events.response:
Glacier Room
This is a large room with giant icicles hanging from the walls and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.

A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>

events.intent: Go east to Troll Room
events.response:
Troll Room
This is a small room with passages off in all directions.  Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.

>

events.intent: Go west to Cellar
events.response:
Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

events.intent: Climb up to Living Room
events.response:
Living Room
This is the living room.  There is a door to the east.  To the west, there is a wooden door with strange gothic lettering and a cyclops-sized hole in it.

In the center of the room is an open trap door.
There is a trophy case here.
Your collection of treasures consists of:
  a free brochure
  a Don Woods stamp
  a red crystal sphere
  a crystal trident
  a blue crystal sphere
  a trunk of jewels
  a golden clockwork canary
  a beautiful brass bauble
  a platinum bar
  a grail
  a jewel-encrusted egg
  a chalice
  a bag of coins
  a masterpiece by a neglected genius

There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT here.
>

events.intent: Go west to Ruby Room
events.response:
Ruby Room
This is a small chamber behind the remains of the great glacier.  To the south and west are small passageways.

On the floor lies a moby ruby.
>

events.intent: Take the moby ruby
events.response:
Taken.

[Your score has just gone up by fifteen points.]

>

events.intent: Descend to Cellar
events.response:
Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

>

events.intent: Go east to Troll Room
events.response:
Troll Room
This is a small room with passages off in all directions.  Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.

>

events.intent: Go west to Lava Room
events.response:
Lava Room
This is a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow.  There are exits here to the west and the south.

>

events.intent: Go south to Volcano Bottom
events.response:
Volcano Bottom
You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano.  High above you, light may be seen entering from the cone of the volcano.  The only exit here is to the north.

There is a very large and extremely heavy wicker basket with a cloth bag here.  Inside the basket is a metal receptacle of some kind.  Attached to the basket on the outside is a piece of wire.
>

events.intent: Go north to EWP
events.response:
East-West Passage
This is a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.

There is a leaflet here.
There is an elvish sword here.
>

events.intent: Go north to Deep Ravine
events.response:
Deep Ravine
This is a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway.  Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine, and a steep staircase descends.

>

events.intent: Enter the balloon basket
events.response:
You get into the basket.

>

events.intent: Open the fuel receptacle
events.response:
You open the metal receptacle.

>

events.intent: Descend to Reservoir South
events.response:
Reservoir South
You are in a long room, to the north of which was formerly a reservoir.  There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway climbing up along the edge of a cliff.

>

events.intent: Go west to Stream View
events.response:
Stream View
You are standing on a path beside a gently flowing stream.  The path travels to the north and the east.

>

events.intent: Load guidebook fuel
events.response:
You put the tour guidebook into the metal receptacle.

>

events.intent: Ignite balloon fuel with candles
events.response:
The tour guidebook burns inside the receptacle.

Volcano Core (in the basket)
You are about one hundred feet above the bottom of the volcano.  The top of the volcano is clearly visible here.

>

events.intent: Go north to Glacier Room
events.response:
Glacier Room
This is a large room with giant icicles hanging from the walls and ceiling.  There are passages to the north and east.

A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
>

     You are inside a rectangular box of wood whose structure is rather complicated.  Four sides and the roof are filled in, and the floor is open.

     In the floor is a stone channel about six inches wide and a foot deep.  The channel is oriented in a north-south direction.  In the exact center of the room, the channel widens into a circular depression, perhaps two feet wide.  Incised in the stone around this area is a compass rose.

     Running from one short wall to the other at about waist height is a wooden bar, carefully carved and drilled.  This bar is pierced in two places.  The first hole is in the center of the bar (and thus the center of the room).  The second is at the left end of the room (as you face opposite the entrance).  Through each hole runs a wooden pole.

To ascertain whether you meet the stringent requirements laid down by the Great Implementers, I will ask three questions, which should be easy for one of your reputed excellence to answer.  You have undoubtedly discovered the answers during your travels through the dungeon.  Should you answer each of these questions correctly within five attempts, then I am obliged to acknowledge your skill and daring and admit you to these regions."

events.intent: Go north along west corridor
events.response:
North Corridor
This is a large east-west corridor which opens out to a northern parapet at its center.  You can see flames and smoke as you peer towards the parapet.  The corridor turns south at its east and west ends, and due south is a massive wooden door.  In the door is a small window barred with iron.  The door is closed.

The dungeon master follows you.

events.intent: Start stiletto leg west
events.response:
Strange Passage
This is a long passage.  To the south is one entrance.  On the east there is an old wooden door with a large hole in it (about cyclops sized).

>

events.intent: Go north to parapet
events.response:
Parapet
You are standing behind a stone retaining wall which rims a large parapet overlooking a fiery pit.  It is difficult to see through the smoke and flame which fills the pit, but it seems to be more or less bottomless.  It also extends upward out of sight.  The pit itself is of roughly dressed stone and circular in shape.  It is about two hundred feet in diameter.  The flames generate considerable heat, so it is rather uncomfortable standing here.  There is an object here which looks like a sundial.  On it are an indicator arrow and (in the center) a large button.  On the face of the dial are numbers "one" through "eight".  The indicator points to the number one.

The dungeon master follows you.

>

events.intent: Continue to Cyclops
events.response:
Cyclops Room
This is a room with an exit on the west side, and a staircase leading up.

The north wall, previously solid, now has a cyclops-shaped hole in it.
>

events.intent: Turn the sundial without a target
events.response:
It is fixed in place.

>

events.intent: Turn sundial indicator to four
events.response:
The dial now points to 4.

>

events.intent: Reach Treasure Room
events.response:
Treasure Room
This is a large room, whose north wall is solid granite.  A number of discarded bags, which crumble at your touch, are scattered about on the floor.  There is an exit down and what appears to be a newly created passage to the east.

There is a stiletto here.
>

events.intent: Take stiletto using everyday synonym dagger
events.response:
You can't see any such thing.

>

events.intent: Order master to push the dial button
events.response:
"If you wish," he replies.

Click.

>

events.intent: Take stiletto with canonical noun
events.response:
Taken.

>

events.intent: Turn sundial indicator to six
events.response:
The dial now points to 6.

>
